account.faqOrderQ: How do I place an order?
account.faqOrderA: Browse any category, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You can pay with card, Strug Wallet, or apply a referral code for discounts.
account.faqTrackQ: How do I track my order?
account.faqTrackA: After placing an order, tap 'Track Order' from your Order History page. You'll see real-time updates as your order is prepared and delivered.
account.faqCancelQ: Can I cancel or change my booking?
account.faqCancelA: Most bookings can be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time. Go to Order History → find the booking → tap 'Cancel'. Fees may apply for late cancellations.
account.faqReferralQ: How does the referral code work?
account.faqReferralA: Share your referral code with friends. When they complete their first purchase using your code, both of you receive a discount on future orders.
account.faqSellerQ: How do I become a seller or provider?
account.faqSellerA: Tap 'More' in the sidebar and find your category (e.g. Sell Food, Provide a Service). Follow the setup steps to launch your storefront.
account.faqPaymentA: Yes. All payments are processed through encrypted channels. We never store full card numbers on our servers.
account.faqContactQ: How do I contact a vendor or host?
account.faqContactA: On any listing or booking detail page, tap 'Message' to open a direct chat with the vendor or host.
account.faqAiA: Strug AI is your personal assistant within the app. It can help you find services, answer questions about your bookings, and give recommendations.
